subject: Confirming invoice generation workflow & delivery preferences
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally.park@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: billing@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New customer invoice setup — Acme Cloud (PO 9342)

Hi Jonas,

We're moving forward with Redwood for inference and need your help to get the first invoice set up. Finance has asked for the following:

- Invoice summary for November usage, delivered by the 15th.
- Send as PDF to billing@acmecloud.com and copy our AP portal ingestion (if you support SFTP/e-invoice, please include that option).
- PO number: 9342 (attached).
- VAT/Tax ID: US-EIN 12-3456789 — please include on the invoice.
- If you can provide an automated SFTP drop or API push we can ingest directly; otherwise email is fine.

Quick questions: what file format will you produce for line items (CSV vs XML)? Do you support consolidated monthly invoices for multiple legal entities?

Attached: acme-po-9342.pdf

Thanks,
Sally Park
Head of Finance — Acme Cloud
Sally Park | sally.park@acmecloud.com

[attachment: acme-po-9342.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sally Park <sally.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New customer invoice setup — Acme Cloud (PO 9342)

Sally — thanks for the details and the PO. Looping in Laura from Billing to coordinate the delivery path. A couple of clarifications so we can generate the invoice exactly as your AP team needs: 

1) Delivery options we support today:
   - Email PDF (encrypted ZIP available on request) — simplest and immediate.
   - SFTP push (we can push a PDF and a CSV line-item extract to your ingest folder).
   - e-invoice (Peppol) or XML/UBL export — requires extra onboarding.

2) File format for line items: we can produce a human-friendly PDF + machine CSV (columns: date, endpoint, usage_tokens, unit_price, line_total). We also support an XML schema (sample link below) if your system prefers it.

3) Consolidation: we can do consolidated monthly invoicing across entities, but we need the legal entity mapping up front (billing-mapping.csv would work).

Laura — can you confirm lead time for generating the November invoice with the PO and EIN included, and whether we can set up a one-time SFTP push for Acme?

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

[links: https://redwood.docs/invoice-schema , https://redwood.drive/acme/onboarding/INV-9342]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Sally Park <sally.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New customer invoice setup — Acme Cloud (PO 9342)

Thanks — Laura here from Billing. We can produce the November invoice and push it by the 15th if we receive final mapping by EOD Monday. A few notes: 

- Preferred delivery: we recommend SFTP push for automated ingestion. If Acme chooses email, we'll send both the PDF invoice and a companion CSV.
- Encryption: we can encrypt PDFs with your public PGP key or supply a password-protected ZIP.
- VAT/EIN: we will print the provided EIN on the invoice. For EU VAT reverse-charge cases we need a VAT validation certificate; for US customers EIN is sufficient.
- Line-item format: CSV is the safe default. Attached is a billing-mapping template (billing-mapping.csv).

Action items:
- Acme: confirm SFTP host and path OR confirm that email to billing@acmecloud.com is the desired final delivery channel.
- Acme: return completed billing-mapping.csv if you want consolidated invoices across entities.
- Jon: please set up the SFTP credentials request if Acme chooses SFTP (we'll coordinate a secure handoff).

cc: Neha — please advise if any tax text or invoice wording is required for the EIN on Redwood invoices.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

[attachment: billing-mapping.csv (text/csv)]

From: Sally Park <sally.park@acmecloud.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New customer invoice setup — Acme Cloud (PO 9342)

Hi Laura, thanks — we'll take the SFTP option. Details below: 

- SFTP host: sftp.acmecloud.ap/ingest (credentials will be provided by our platform team separately).
- Desired payload: monthly PDF invoice + companion CSV (your CSV template is perfect).
- PO 9342 should be present on the invoice header and on every line item reference.
- Please include EIN 12-3456789 on the invoice.
- We do not need consolidated invoices across entities for now — single-entity only.

We'll share SFTP username and public key by EOD Monday. Once that's set up, please push November's invoice by the 15th.

Thanks for moving quickly.
Sally

--
Sally Park
Head of Finance, Acme Cloud
[attachment: acme-po-9342.pdf (application/pdf)]
